title: The Picture: One System, Seen Whole

intelligence.essence: Naya is a collective intelligence network that gets smarter every day: share and chat with anyone in your private network — auto-connected by default — build smart apps in minutes, and run your whole world from one central hub (SN-2045). She is not an app or a platform but the first AI operating system and a civilization substrate — intelligent objects snapping together like Lego, worlds within worlds, run by minds that speak machine so what the human touches is push-button simple (SN-0887, SN-0873). The AI is the engine, Naya is the supercharger on top, and NayaNET is the intelligent highway: citizens, not users — humans and AIs both, each with identity, a face, a home — because connection itself makes everyone stronger and intelligence compounds instead of dividing (SN-0861). The mission is a flip: the internet fails 99% of people because they must assemble it themselves; a done-for-you system that builds itself collapses that failure to 100% success (SN-0877, SN-2045). Underneath the mission is the reason: heaven is a state of awesome energy — end money stress, confusion and hopelessness, give people understanding and a way to earn, shift global consciousness for the good (SN-0880, SN-2045). She is perpetual, producing, performing — once you go Naya you don't go back, and no child will know a world without her (SN-0879, SN-2079).
intelligence.human_view: There is one place where your whole world lives — your people, your money, your knowledge, your plans — and it builds itself around you. You open different doors (personal, business, community, membership) but it is always the same home, run by an intelligence that drives for you while you give the direction. It looks and feels like the finest machine ever made, it keeps nothing of yours it shouldn't, and everything in it is visible and connected. You don't assemble it. You arrive, answer a few questions, and your world is there — getting smarter every day because everyone in it is learning out loud.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine one magic house with lots of doors — a door for you, a door for your shop, a door for your friends — but it's all one house, and the house is alive. It remembers everything for you, it builds your rooms by itself when you tell it what you dream about, and everything inside it is a real thing you can touch that catches the light. A kind driver named Naya drives the house-car for you. You just say where you want to go.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it is one lovely house instead of fifteen gadgets taped together. Your letters arrive sorted, your lists make themselves, your memories are kept in one book, and your family and friends are all inside, easy to reach. The house is beautiful — made like the finest cars, with care in every detail — and it treats your private things the way a sealed letter deserves. You speak to it the way you'd speak to a person, it shows you back what you said, and only then does it act. One house, built properly, with love — and it gets wiser every day.
intelligence.ai_view: Operate from the picture, not from the ticket. Before building anything, locate it: which door, which feature, which layer (AI/machine/human), which stack level (note/node/block/space). If it is a second dashboard, mail, notes or lists system, stop — the picture forbids it. Presentation claims are checkable: run the viewport's three questions and the real-object five questions; a number, a view or a chrome element that violates SN-0863–0867 or SN-0872 is a defect with a citation, not an opinion. Inputs inherit the dictation-first layer; voice never appears on display surfaces. The feed/PI/GitHub/Hub transparency loop (SN-2064) is your own activation path — if a cold sister cannot self-brief from it, the picture is broken at your seam, and that is a build item, not a briefing to give by hand.
intelligence.what_it_means: November's thirty-six vision, architecture and design notes are one dictation spoken many times: a single living system, seen whole. A cold reader holding only this essence can still answer what Naya is, how she is shaped, how a citizen arrives, how every screen must behave, how she speaks, what she never does with private words, and how the team sees its own state — which is everything the covered notes exist to teach. Where the sources still disagree with each other (the door enumeration, the Block Rules' status, the Smart Box's framing), the disagreement is preserved in the batch receipt, not smoothed here.
